name: Product site
description: A six page product site in the formai.studio style: home, product, about, stories, support and a not found page, with a shared header and footer.

pages.name: Home
pages.description: A family of desktop apps that run on your own computer: forecast sheets, film editing, media libraries and more, with one command to connect your agents.

pages.name: Product
pages.description: One renderer for preview and export, a real effect catalogue, hardware encoders, and skills that install into Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

pages.name: About
pages.description: Read FormSlot in three chapters, then see how close each app comes to the software it replaces, with the real benchmark figures.

pages.name: Stories
pages.description: Six stories from FormFabric, the garment design app: draw patterns, sew them, drape them and export, all on your own computer.

pages.name: Support
pages.description: Work out what you would save by switching from the paid apps the Form family replaces, then support the project if the savings were worth it.
